# NearbyShare (vendored)

Quick Share receiver code from [NearDrop](https://github.com/grishka/NearDrop), `NearbyShare/` folder, copied unchanged from `third_party/NearDrop`. License: Unlicense (see `UNLICENSE`).

Mirror builds it as the `NearbyShare` Swift package target and supplies its own `MainAppDelegate` (`Sources/MirrorDesk/QuickShareReceiver.swift`), so there is no second menu bar icon. To update, copy the folder again from a newer NearDrop checkout and rerun `swift test`.
